## IndexSelector interface

Select the object at a zero-based position within its container.

**Signature:**

```typescript
interface IndexSelector
```

## Remarks

Positions are zero-based and non-negative: `0` is the first object. A negative position is invalid; a position past the end is detectable only when the reference is resolved.
